text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
—Hraaaah!!
This is what I'm truly made of!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I can't lose to anyone...!
I'm gonna win, 'cause I'm the strongest!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"WOOOOOOOOO!!!!
Tamamo Croooooosssss!!"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Dammit, damn it...!
Da... mmiiit...!!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"I lost... ngh.
I lost...!"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Damn it, it hurts...!
It's frustrating, frustrating, frustrating, frustrating...!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...!
Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Hey, I get it now.
My running really was pathetic, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Because even when I lost before, it never felt this frustrating.
It's never hurt enough to make me shake like this...!"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: More importantly, it was more crucial for me to listen carefully and pick up on what people thought of me.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I cared so much about what everyone else was saying that I didn't even know the sound of my own heartbeat...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
It's loud, and it's intense.
And it's just screaming the whole time.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer.
I...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I want to run.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I need to run even, even, even more!
And win... I want to win!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I want to win!!
I don't want to lose to anyone anymore...!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Yeah!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After the race, I headed toward Gold City, who was still gazing out at the turf with lingering excitement—

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text: City...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Mane-G... wait, what!?
Whoa, why are you crying...?

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text: "...Even now, I still believe you are at your most beautiful when you're modeling."

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
Bathed in the spotlight, captivating everyone who watches,
you shine brighter than anything else in this world.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text: “Still... you were so... so very beautiful today too.”

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
A run filled with pure joy,
overflowing with the love of racing...
It was like light itself.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
It's just like the first time I found you.
Seeing you sprint across the turf
completely took my breath away...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Mane-G...

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
Even while acting reluctant, you trusted the adults
and flawlessly delivered everything expected of you
on the job, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
And the one thing you desired of your own will……
was racing, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
...I don't intend to force you to stop anymore.
Do as you please.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
Still, please, I beg of you,
don't do anything that might hurt someone.
Not their face—and not their heart.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
If racing only brings you pain,
this time, I'll definitely make you quit.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text: Trainer, please... take good care of City.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
—Seriously, they're way too overprotective.
Getting a few scratches is totally normal.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
If you can only put it like that,
...nothing's gonna get through to them.
choice_data_list: You really are awkward, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I'm pretty sure Mane-G wouldn't
want to hear that from you either.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What's that supposed to mean?
...Good grief.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
So, about our next race...
After the Osaka Hai and the Tenno Sho (Spring), the next one would be—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...I wonder if Tamamo-senpai will run again?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Then that's perfect.
It pisses me off being ignored like this anyway.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Even if I have to force it, I need them to hear what I have to say...!
